content_html_sanitized:
Posted February 19, 2005

Dear Readers:

I am pleased to announce that I will be doing the MarijuanaNews World Report twice weekly - Tuesdays and Fridays - on Pot-TV.net. I enjoy working in video, and being able to rant is frankly therapeutic for me.

I have been very gratified by how well the first two programs were received. I am a bit out of practice, but I am getting accustomed to challenge of the live-to-tape shoots again. I think that the spontaneity of that approach to the program makes it more enjoyable for everyone.

Also, Advanced Nutrients and I have mutually agreed to cancel the sale of MarijuanaNews.com to AN. I wish my friends there every success, and I look forward to working with them in the future in the common cause of ending marijuana prohibition. I very much appreciate their support over the last year.

There may be some changes in format for MarijuanaNews, but I especially want to be able to do longer pieces. As part of this change, I want to mine the archives of MarijuanaNews for one or more books.

I want to organize the archived material into chapters on the various topics, exploring new ways to say, Let me try to explain it this way.

I hope that these chapters can then be organized into one or more books, but at the very least it will make the material on MarijuanaNews more useful to activists and researchers.

For the most part the prohibitionists just keep telling the same lies, and I find myself responding with There they go again and pointing out where we have heard it all before with numerous links to the archives. Doing news and commentary on Pot-TV allows me the freedom to express my contempt for their dishonesty in a way that is difficult in print. There will be a regular update to MarijuanaNews next Thursday, but in the meantime please check out Pot-TV.net.

Many thanks to all of you.
Sincerely,

Richard Cowan
